department: Bioinformatics (interuniversity; School of Mathematics and Statistics, FME)

deadline.value: Applications are accepted throughout the academic year under UPC's general rule; the programme page sets no separate date.
deadline.quote: As a general rule, you can apply for a doctoral programme throughout the academic year.

supervisor.value: An endorsement from a researcher who will serve as potential supervisor must be submitted with the application.
supervisor.quote: Students must submit an endorsement from a researcher willing to serve as the potential supervisor for their doctoral thesis.

funding.value: UPC predoctoral grants are awarded through annual general calls; the programme pages do not say how many students are funded.
funding.quote: General calls of predoctoral grants, financed by state and autonomous public bodies, the UPC, and private foundations.

entry_route.value: The main route is a research master's in bioinformatics or a related discipline.
entry_route.quote: the primary and preferred pathway for admission to the Program is the completion of a research-oriented master's degree

also.quote: have completed a bachelor’s degree of at least 300 ECTS credits

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the programme pages.

english_waiver.value: English at B2 is required; without a certificate the local coordinator tests it in an interview. No rule for Indian or English-medium degrees is stated.

notes: Recorded under Biology & Biosciences as the nearest UPC PhD; the Agri-Food Technology and Biotechnology programme is not saved, since its scope is agri-food rather than biology. The programme's own pages were not fetched; the overview on doctorat.upc.edu was used.
name: Bioinformatics
